name: Free and total storage
plain: Reads exact free and total disk bytes with no prompt; on iOS this needs a declared reason.
meaning: Exact free bytes change slowly and are near-unique, so they are a classic fingerprint. It also reveals device tier (64 GB vs 512 GB) and how full the phone is.

android.note: Exact byte counts; quota-aware allocatable bytes since Android 8

ios.revocation: App Review: privacy manifest reasons must be declared; fingerprinting banned
ios.api_surface: Reason codes 85F4.1 (display), E174.1 (low-space behavior), 7D9E.1 (user-sent bug report), B728.1 (health research apps); enforced in App Store submissions since 2024-05-01

limits.headline: Can see free and total storage on Android, and on iPhone only with a stated reason
limits.user_action: Nothing. The app checks when it starts, or before a big download
can: See exact free and total storage in bytes on Android
See how much space the app could free up on Android 8 and newer
Check space on iPhone for approved reasons, such as showing it to you or a low space warning
Warn you before a download that will not fit
cannot: See the space on iPhone without declaring an approved reason; App Store checks began 1 May 2024
Use the number on iPhone for tracking or a device ID
See what is stored in other apps' folders
limits.differs: Android allows it with no prompt. iPhone only allows it for listed reasons the developer must declare.

story.what_it_is: An app can see how much free and total storage your phone has.

marketing.name: Required Reason APIs
marketing.pitch: Developer rule: apps that read free disk space must declare an approved reason in their privacy manifest.

story.for_you: You may see a warning that you need more space to download a movie. You will not see that the exact number of free bytes works like a near unique tag, because it changes slowly.
story.for_makers: Makers need it to check space before big downloads and saves. The same exact number is a classic fingerprint, so Apple makes apps give a reason.

use_cases.example: A streaming app checks free space before offering to download a whole series.
A game warns you that an update needs 4 GB before it starts downloading.
A video app checks space before it starts recording in 4K.
A cleaner app shows how full your phone is and what to delete.
An ad firm uses free bytes plus total size to tell phones apart.
A fraud tool notes that a device claims 64 GB but shows free space of a 512 GB model.

risks: Exact number works as a tag
Shows how full your phone is
story.android_note: Reads exact free and total bytes with no prompt.
story.ios_note: Needs a declared reason code in the privacy manifest.

technical_bounds: Reason codes restrict off-device sending on iOS

history.change: Disk space is a Required Reason API; manifest reason required to ship
